Amount of USDAX (18 dec) to deposit.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

addRewards(uint256).notice: Fund the reward pool with USDAX (caller must approve first).

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposit USDAX into the savings module.

pendingRewards(address).notice: USDAX rewards accrued but not yet claimed by `user`.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraw principal USDAX (does NOT auto-claim rewards).
